recorded.prompt:q-map-subclass-reserve: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-map-subclass-reserve: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-map-subclass-reserve: Page decides b: a subclass's synchronized method excludes only code that locks this, and 'Inheriting from ConcurrentHashMap to add a synchronized compound method fails as the list subclass did: the map's own methods never lock the map object (unit 6.5.2).' Reference table: ConcurrentHashMap locks 'per bin, for writes; never the map object'. The reader must transfer the forced-interleaving CopyOnWriteArrayList demo to the map, which the page explicitly licenses.

[183, 250, ...]'. Page example uses Collections.synchronizedList; the Reference table extends wrapper locking to synchronizedMap, so the transfer is supported.
recorded.prompt:q-recipient-set-shared-list: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recipient-set-shared-list: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recipient-set-shared-list: Page decides d: 'the guarantee holds only while the list stays private: a constructor that stored a list the caller passed in, or a getter that returned it, would give callers a path around the lock.' Also 'no reference to it leaves the class, so every access goes through lock'.
recorded.prompt:q-eager-session: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-eager-session: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-eager-session: Page decides d: 'every call built a limiter ... the value is an argument, so it exists before the map sees the key. Where the constructor ... opens a connection, that work runs on every lookup, not once per client.' Note: d says 'a new connection for every request'; the page supports that a connection is opened every call, though the backend also sees the discarded ones (the page doesn't discuss closing them).

recorded.prompt:q-map-subclass-reserve:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-map-subclass-reserve:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-map-subclass-reserve:a: Refuted by the heading 'A Subclass's synchronized Method Excludes Only Code That Locks this' and the demo where addIfAbsent 'didn't wait'; the map case is stated as the same failure.
recorded.prompt:q-map-subclass-reserve:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-map-subclass-reserve:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-map-subclass-reserve:c: Refuted: reserve is a synchronized method, so it locks this (Summary bullet 1; 'two subscribe calls on the same object can't overlap'). Partly true: the put inside reserve and putIfAbsent do lock a bin (Reference table 'per bin, for writes'), and the conclusion 'booked twice' is right; only the stated reason is wrong. A reader could be tempted, but the page does settle it.
recorded.prompt:q-map-subclass-reserve:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-map-subclass-reserve:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-map-subclass-reserve:d: Refuted: '`contains` and `add` are each atomic' yet the run shows 'copies of the URL: 2'; 'The window is the stretch between contains and add'. Page states this for the list; the map transfer is by analogy.

recorded.outcome:q-cart-service-per-request:c: Refuted: the synchronized method locks the service, one per handler, and the one-per-thread run produced duplicates.
recorded.prompt:q-cart-service-per-request:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cart-service-per-request:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cart-service-per-request:d: Refuted: wrapper locks 'for one call each'; the caller must synchronize on the wrapper to span calls (client-side locking).
recorded.prompt:q-recipient-set-shared-list:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recipient-set-shared-list:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recipient-set-shared-list:a: Refuted by the same 'path around the lock' sentence; nothing makes unlocked callers wait. The page does not spell out the exact interleaving, but the race window between check and add is shown earlier ('The window is the stretch between contains and add').
recorded.prompt:q-recipient-set-shared-list:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recipient-set-shared-list:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recipient-set-shared-list:b: Refuted by inference: synchronizedList methods 'lock the returned wrapper'; SubscriberSet uses 'private final Object lock'. The page never states the combination (wrapped list stored in a privately locked class) directly, so the reader must combine two sections; also the job's own contains+add is a non-atomic pair even under the wrapper.
recorded.prompt:q-recipient-set-shared-list:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recipient-set-shared-list:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recipient-set-shared-list:c: Refuted by the code: snapshot() and subscribe both use synchronized (lock), so a copy never sees a half-done add. 'Copying stores nothing' is common sense, not stated text. Weakest refutation of the set but adequate.
recorded.prompt:q-eager-session:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-eager-session:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-eager-session:a: Refuted: putIfAbsent is used 'correctly, returning the winner'; '70,000 were thrown away' (not stored); 'clients given two limiters: 0'. Partly true: a new connection is opened every request, matching d's outcome; only the reason (overwrite) is wrong.

recorded.outcome:q-eager-session:b: Refuted: 'the value is an argument, so it exists before the map sees the key'.
